_comment: ANC test configuration. Keys prefixed with '_comment' are documentation only and ignored at runtime.

anc._comment_description: Human-readable label for this suite; shown in logs/reports.
anc._comment_inactivity_timeout: Per-group INACTIVITY timeout in seconds (900 = 15 min). A group is aborted only after this many seconds with NO new ANC output; a group that keeps printing progress runs as long as it needs (no total wall-clock cap). Raise this only if a legitimate ANC item can stay silent longer than the default between output lines.
anc._comment_install_timeout: Package download+install INACTIVITY timeout in seconds (1800 = 30 min), used only by anc_installation / the install pre-task. It is a per-read (no-output) timeout, not a total budget: the download prints a periodic progress heartbeat so a slow link never trips it, while a genuine stall still fails. Raise this only if download+extract of the large content package legitimately needs longer between output lines.
anc._comment_anc_version: Expected ANC version. The install pre-task skips (re)installation when this version is already present on the node, and post-verifies the install matches.
anc._comment_anc_release_url: URL of the ANC release archive to download and install. Flavour (deb/rpm/tar) is auto-detected from the filename.
anc._comment_print_all_to_console: 'True' echoes ANC group output to the console; 'False' suppresses it (install/ldconfig/version diagnostics still print).
anc._comment_log_folder_path: Controller-side destination PREFIX for ALL ANC artifacts (collected logs AND the auto-collected HTML report). Set it to a plain directory path (a leading '~' is expanded to your home directory) under which CVS lays down its own per-node/per-test/per-run folder structure. Required: replace 'REPLACE_ME' before running. To send the HTML report elsewhere, pass --html on the command line.
anc._comment_ADD_ANC_LOGS_TO_HTML_REPORTS: 'True' always bundles the collected ANC log tree into the pytest-html report zip. 'False' (default) bundles it only when the test fails, so passing runs stay lean while failures always carry their logs.
anc._comment_COLLECT_HTML_REPORTS: 'True' (default) auto-generates a pytest-html report even when no --html is passed on the command line, written under log_folder_path. 'False' disables auto-collection (a report is produced only if you pass --html explicitly). An explicit --html on the command line always overrides the auto-collected path.
